title: Affine ideal-power coefficient span
statement: With the data of lem-weil-pbc-ideal-powers-local-coefficient-span, if W is affine and W ≤ U, then every section of the ideal-power module product over W maps under the product inclusion into the span of the restricted generators with coefficients from I^m.

proof.text: Use the affine section formulas for quasi-coherent modules and extended ideals, induct on the recursive idealSheafPower, and expand ideal-module product membership as finite sums. Rewrite each module factor using the spanning hypothesis.

lean.statement:
theorem idealPowersLocalCoefficientSpan_affine {A : Type v} [CommRing A]
    {X : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    (I : Ideal A) (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (r : ℕ) (u : Fin r → Γ(F, U))
    (hu : Submodule.span Γ(X, U) (Set.range u) = ⊤)
    (m : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hWU : W ≤ U)
    (t : (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι m).2 F).val.obj
      (op W)) :
    ((Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι m).2 F).app
        W).hom t ∈
      Submodule.span Γ(X, W)
        {z | ∃ (i : Fin r) (a : A), a ∈ I ^ m ∧
          z = (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv ≫
            f.appLE ⊤ W le_top).hom a) •
              F.val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (u i)}
